name: Weapons of Elunite
summary: In Darnassus, Weapons of Elunite brings a young warrior's rite of passage to its end. You carry ore blessed by Elune to Mathiel, who forges it into arms for a defender of Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Sacred Forge
sections.body: Night elf warriors defend Teldrassil and the kaldorei people. Promising young warriors gather elunite, a mineral blessed by the Moon Goddess, to arm themselves beyond ordinary steel. Its ore needs a smith skilled in metalcraft and mindful of Elune's gift.

sections.title: Mathiel's Craft
sections.body: Mathiel works in Darnassus, shaping blessed elunite into weapons of war. He considers the work an honor, not routine metalcraft. Bring him the ore, and he forges arms to suit your style. For your service, he gives you weapons blessed by your goddess.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: A young warrior's rite of passage in Darnassus ends when you bring elunite ore to Smith Mathiel. He forges weapons blessed by Elune to aid your journey across Kalimdor.
Mathiel is a skilled night elf smith who lives in Darnassus. He can forge elunite into balanced arms for the city's defenders.
Elunite is a rare mineral sacred to the night elves, believed to hold Elune's luminescence and favor. Shaping it into weapons is a solemn honor for a smith.
Alliance warriors training near Darnassus can undertake this after finding and gathering elunite for Smith Mathiel.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You bring the ore to Smith Mathiel in Darnassus, the night elf capital high in the boughs of Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Mathiel thank the adventurer?
faq.answer: Mathiel thanks you because shaping elunite is both a sacred honor and a personal pleasure. Few smiths have the privilege of working ore tied to Elune, so your delivery is a boon to him.

angles.text: As a young kaldorei warrior, you mark an early rite of martial service and receive dependable weapons blessed by Elune.
As a night elf, you see reverence for the Moon Goddess joined to the practical craft of war and defense.
As a blacksmith, you see Mathiel balance ordinary metalwork with the care needed to shape sacred elunite.
